notes: Reviews and rejects are not placed. Every pin is provisional: points that are rounded to a minute, area/reserve centroids, trail routes and parks are set to coordinates null (provisional_coordinates_unverified kept for reasoning only); Pipeline C must resolve each with resolve-pin (route midpoint for walks, visitor point for parks and reserves, town centre for towns). Redbank Gorge candidate point is wrong (near Serpentine Gorge). Hours, cost and ticketUrl are null with needs_research everywhere except two free spots; visitHours are estimates from the sourced walk lengths and durations. Uluru-Kata Tjuta park pass/entry fee, uluru.gov.au and nt.gov.au park pages are candidate ticketUrl sources, not verified. Sensitive sites: Uluru and Kata Tjuta visitor copy must respect Anangu guidance (no climbing, photography limits at sacred sites). Destination ids new, none in git history.
